# Heavy / on-demand (install via the helpers in 00_setup or per-tool docs; pin what you actually use):
# --- Scaffolding (the A100-bound step) ---
# RFdiffusion        # classic motif scaffolding (free-tier DEMO): https://github.com/RosettaCommons/RFdiffusion ; pin the commit
# RFdiffusion2       # all-atom motif scaffolding (Dauparas 2025) — VERIFY current public release/repo at generation time
# Riff-Diff          # motif->protein scaffolding (Schnettler 2025, Nature) — VERIFY current public release/repo at generation time
# --- Sequence design (CPU-fast) — THE CENTRAL TOOL ---
# LigandMPNN         # ligand/metal-aware, fixes coordinating residues + passes the cofactor as context: https://github.com/dauparas/LigandMPNN ; pin the version
# --- Structure prediction (coordinating-residue geometry + site pLDDT) ---
# colabfold          # AF2 — prefer the official ColabFold notebook; pin the commit. (ESMFold via transformers for fast triage.)
#                    #   NOTE: AF2 predicts the APO backbone — it does NOT place the cofactor/metal.
# transformers>=4.40 # ESMFold triage (EsmForProteinFolding)
# --- Cofactor docking + dynamics ---
# (AutoDock) vina    # cofactor fit (heme macrocycle / cluster): https://github.com/ccsb-scripps/AutoDock-Vina ; pin the version
# openmm             # short pocket/coordination MD: https://github.com/openmm/openmm ; pin the version
#                    #   NOTE: classical metal/heme force fields are APPROXIMATE — MD here is a weak, caveated proxy.
# pdbfixer           # structure prep for OpenMM
#
# COMPUTE REALITY (see MANUAL.md §2 + MASTER_BLUEPRINT §3): scaffolding 1000s of cofactor-pocket
# backbones with RFdiffusion2/Riff-Diff wants an A100 (Colab Pro+ or HPC). LigandMPNN is CPU-fast;
# ESMFold/AF2 triage runs on a free T4; short MD on small systems is feasible on a T4 (but is a weak
# proxy for a metal site). Free-tier path = a small RFdiffusion motif-scaffolding demo + LigandMPNN
